:::{#exm-self-outer-product}
#### A self outer product

For $\vx = (1, 2)$,
the [self outer product](#def-self-outer-product) is

$$
\ba
\soprod{\vx}
&= \begin{bmatrix} 1 \\ 2 \end{bmatrix}
\begin{bmatrix} 1 & 2 \end{bmatrix}
&& \text{(definition of the self outer product)}
\\
&= \begin{bmatrix}
1 \cd 1 & 1 \cd 2 \\
2 \cd 1 & 2 \cd 2
\end{bmatrix}
&& \text{(entry } (i, j) \text{ is } x_i x_j \text{)}
\\
&= \begin{bmatrix}
1 & 2 \\
2 & 4
\end{bmatrix}
&& \text{(multiply)}
\ea
$$
